# Pavan Nallamothu - Offensive Security Tooling and Exploits

> Offensive security researcher. 12 published CVEs across Apple, CISA, NSA, AutoGPT, yt-dlp and BlueprintUE, plus two open-access papers (Zenodo). Every claim below links to an independent, third-party source that credits "pavanchow" / "Pavan Nallamothu".

This site (pavanchow.github.io) is the technical hub: per-CVE detail, reproduction scripts, the two papers, and 61 from-scratch systems tools. The researcher/credentials hub is pavanchow.gitlab.io. Each CVE line points to the vendor or GitHub Security Advisory that names the reporter, not to a self-authored page.

## Coined term
- [EPI-SSRF (Egress-Path-Incomplete SSRF)](https://pavanchow.github.io/epi-ssrf/): a class of SSRF where the egress guard covers only a subset of outbound clients (coverage defect P subset of E), so an alternate egress path such as SMTP bypasses the guard. Coined by Pavan Nallamothu in the paper SSRF Beyond HTTP (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22075469), instantiated on CVE-2026-33234 (AutoGPT).

## Open-source systems tools (Rust, each its own live page)
### Compilers, languages, and runtimes
- [Alchemist](https://pavanchow.github.io/alchemist/): a compiler that lexes, parses, and lowers a small language to stack bytecode, then runs it on a bundled VM
- [Anvil](https://pavanchow.github.io/anvil/): a compiler backend that lowers SSA to a target machine with graph-coloring register allocation
- [Esperanto](https://pavanchow.github.io/esperanto/): a small statically-typed language with type inference
- [Kindling](https://pavanchow.github.io/kindling/): a dynamically typed language with a bytecode compiler and a stack-based virtual machine
- [Mirage](https://pavanchow.github.io/mirage/): a small bytecode virtual machine with its own instruction set, assembler, and runner
- [Sprite](https://pavanchow.github.io/sprite/): a tiny embeddable scripting language with lexer, recursive-descent parser, and tree-walking interpreter
- [Whetstone](https://pavanchow.github.io/whetstone/): a compiler optimizer with constant folding, propagation, and algebraic simplification
- [Phantom](https://pavanchow.github.io/phantom/): a CHIP-8 emulator with a fully unit-tested CPU core

### Operating systems and kernels
- [Aurora](https://pavanchow.github.io/aurora/): an amnesic aarch64 kernel that runs in RAM, encrypts its vault in memory, and wipes secrets on exit
- [Bedrock](https://pavanchow.github.io/bedrock/): a from-scratch virtual CPU, assembler, and preemptive OS kernel you can boot in the browser
- [Chronos](https://pavanchow.github.io/chronos/): a CPU scheduler running FIFO, SJF, round-robin, priority, and MLFQ over real processes
- [Cocoon](https://pavanchow.github.io/cocoon/): a rootless Linux container runtime using namespaces, pivot_root, and dropped capabilities
- [Conch](https://pavanchow.github.io/conch/): a Unix shell with a hand-written tokenizer, pipeline parser, and process wiring
- [Emberchip](https://pavanchow.github.io/emberchip/): a deterministic RTOS simulator on an emulated microcontroller with priority inheritance
- [Honeycomb](https://pavanchow.github.io/honeycomb/): a readable global memory allocator with live stats
- [Ignition](https://pavanchow.github.io/ignition/): a deterministic boot sequence simulator with an MBR parser, zero dependencies
- [Nesthost](https://pavanchow.github.io/nesthost/): a deterministic type-1 hypervisor simulator that runs several guest VMs
- [Pane](https://pavanchow.github.io/pane/): a dependency-free tiling window manager engine
- [Seedcore](https://pavanchow.github.io/seedcore/): a deterministic microkernel simulator with threads, address spaces, and synchronization
- [Terrarium](https://pavanchow.github.io/terrarium/): a from-scratch scripting sandbox that runs untrusted code under resource limits

### Security and cryptography
- [Cipherlock](https://pavanchow.github.io/cipherlock/): encryption toolkit with from-scratch ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (RFC 8439 vectors)
- [Gatekeeper](https://pavanchow.github.io/gatekeeper/): an auth server with HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens and salted password hashing, no crypto crates
- [Ironchain](https://pavanchow.github.io/ironchain/): a from-scratch proof-of-work blockchain whose only primitive is SHA-256
- [Lint-Owl](https://pavanchow.github.io/lint-owl/): static analyzer returning the data-flow path from source to sink
- [Oracle](https://pavanchow.github.io/oracle/): query language whose result is an attack path across identity and network graphs
- [Unweave](https://pavanchow.github.io/unweave/): EVM bytecode disassembler that reconstructs intent and flags dangerous opcodes
- [Veilproof](https://pavanchow.github.io/veilproof/): a zero-knowledge proof system with no crypto crates and no elliptic curves

### Networking and web
- [Datagram](https://pavanchow.github.io/datagram/): a TCP reliable-transport engine over a simulated lossy link
- [Echofront](https://pavanchow.github.io/echofront/): a layer 7 reverse proxy and load balancer with health checks and circuit breaking
- [Ferryman](https://pavanchow.github.io/ferryman/): a load balancer with round-robin, weighted, least-connections, and seeded random strategies
- [Hearth](https://pavanchow.github.io/hearth/): an HTTP server from scratch on std::net, no framework
- [Kaleidoscope](https://pavanchow.github.io/kaleidoscope/): a browser engine with HTML parser, CSS parser, cascade, block layout, and paint
- [Lighthouse](https://pavanchow.github.io/lighthouse/): a browser rendering engine that runs HTML and CSS through parse, layout, and paint
- [Rift](https://pavanchow.github.io/rift/): reverse proxy whose routing rules are a compiled DSL
- [Riverbed](https://pavanchow.github.io/riverbed/): a message broker with topics, wildcard subscriptions, and bounded per-subscriber queues
- [Semaphore](https://pavanchow.github.io/semaphore/): length-prefixed framing codec plus a typed request/response protocol over TCP
- [Tollgate](https://pavanchow.github.io/tollgate/): a from-scratch API gateway where routing, auth, and rate limiting are a pure pipeline

### Data and storage
- [Archipelago](https://pavanchow.github.io/archipelago/): a distributed file system with quorum writes, self-healing, and content-addressed chunks
- [Conduit](https://pavanchow.github.io/conduit/): a from-scratch PostgreSQL driver speaking the v3 wire protocol with hand-written SCRAM-SHA-256
- [Flashvault](https://pavanchow.github.io/flashvault/): an LRU cache with TTL expiry, a capacity bound, and live stats
- [Flint](https://pavanchow.github.io/flint/): embedded single-binary key-value store, append-only log with in-memory index
- [Keystone](https://pavanchow.github.io/keystone/): a durable, ordered, embedded key-value store written from scratch
- [Ledgerstone](https://pavanchow.github.io/ledgerstone/): an embedded relational database with a real SQL subset and a hand-written executor
- [Strata](https://pavanchow.github.io/strata/): a file system inside one container file: superblock, bitmap allocator, inodes, directories
- [Timelace](https://pavanchow.github.io/timelace/): content-addressed version-control core with blobs, trees, and commits
- [Trailhead](https://pavanchow.github.io/trailhead/): full-text search engine with inverted index and TF-IDF ranking

### Graphics, audio, and machine learning
- [Forge](https://pavanchow.github.io/forge/): a dependency-free 2D game engine with an ECS, a fixed-timestep loop, and impulse-based physics
- [Loom](https://pavanchow.github.io/loom/): a dependency-free retained-mode GUI layout engine
- [Newton](https://pavanchow.github.io/newton/): a 2D physics engine with semi-implicit Euler, circle collision, and impulse resolution
- [Prism](https://pavanchow.github.io/prism/): a software rasterizer that draws 3D triangles on the CPU with a z-buffer, no GPU
- [Reverb](https://pavanchow.github.io/reverb/): audio synthesis engine with oscillators, an ADSR envelope, and a WAV writer
- [Synapse](https://pavanchow.github.io/synapse/): reverse-mode autograd engine that trains a network on XOR

### Developer tools
- [Atelier](https://pavanchow.github.io/atelier/): a dependency-free code-intelligence engine with go to definition, find references, diagnostics, and rename
- [Bloodhound](https://pavanchow.github.io/bloodhound/): a portable time-travel debugger that steps backward through a running program
- [Metronome](https://pavanchow.github.io/metronome/): cron scheduler around a pure, unit-tested schedule engine
- [Quartermaster](https://pavanchow.github.io/quartermaster/): a from-scratch package manager with a PubGrub dependency resolver that explains conflicts
- [Quill](https://pavanchow.github.io/quill/): a dependency-free editable text buffer backed by a piece table
- [Quorum](https://pavanchow.github.io/quorum/): a deterministic Raft consensus simulator with leader election and log replication
- [Relay](https://pavanchow.github.io/relay/): a from-scratch CI/CD engine whose scheduler is a pure, deterministic DAG executor
- [Shepherd](https://pavanchow.github.io/shepherd/): a Kubernetes-style reconciliation control loop that schedules pods onto nodes
- [Stopwatch](https://pavanchow.github.io/stopwatch/): a profiler with a call tree of self time and total time
